scope: Public review observations for the eight indexed cinema venues, including inherited-place historical reviews. Not a complete Google or Tripadvisor export.

method.summary_type: Short original English paraphrases of visible visitor opinions
method.deduplication: Source, public author and text fingerprint within source. Cross-platform duplicates cannot be reliably resolved without original review IDs.
method.review_authenticity: Not verified; star ratings and counts are as displayed by the named source.
method.relative_dates: Preserved verbatim; page retrieval date is not assumed to anchor the publisher cache.
method.original_review_links: Not exposed by these sources; source listing links retained.
method.sampling: Visible public cards/index excerpts, not representative or random; no combined sentiment score calculated.
